html:
Mexico is the large country between the United States and Central America, independent since 1821. It grew from the Spanish Viceroyalty of New Spain, which was built on the ruins of the Aztec Empire.

The priest Miguel Hidalgo began the war of independence in 1810, and independence came in 1821. The young country lost Texas in 1836 and half its land in the Mexican-American War of 1846 to 1848. Benito Juárez led liberal reforms and beat back a French invasion that set up Maximilian as emperor from 1864 to 1867.

In the years shown on the map from 1880:

  • Porfirio Díaz ruled from 1876 to 1911, bringing railways, foreign investment and order, while most land fell into a few hands.
  • The Mexican Revolution from 1910 overthrew him and cost hundreds of thousands of lives. The Constitution of 1917 promised land reform and workers' rights.
  • One party, later called the PRI, ruled from 1929 to 2000. Lázaro Cárdenas handed out land to villages and took over the foreign oil companies in 1938.
  • Fast growth from the 1940s built Mexico City into one of the largest cities in the world.

Debt crises in the 1980s pushed Mexico toward free trade, and NAFTA with the United States and Canada began in 1994, the same day as the Zapatista uprising in Chiapas. The PRI lost the presidency in 2000. Since 2006 a war against drug cartels has killed many thousands.
sum: Mexico is the large country between the United States and Central America, independent since 1821. It grew from the Spanish Viceroyalty of New Spain, which was built on the ruins of the Aztec Empire.
